title: VTC Events — Announcements — List — payload
description: Read an event's announcements: its hosts, and its registrants who are going, maybe, pending or waitlisted, newest first. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Events — Announcements — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/announcements/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/announcements/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
